verdict.rationale: Stagehand documents natural-language act() ("click the login button"), observe() for discovering actionable elements, and a selfHeal option that re-infers an action when its recorded selector breaks. It is built on accessibility-tree page understanding and handles iframes and shadow DOM automatically. A community comment describes dynamically regenerated actions as resilient to DOM changes. Missing for 10: independent hands-on evidence that actions survive real selector and layout changes, since the resilience comment reads like a maker's claim.
